sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भीमनिर्ह्रादं शक्राशनिसमस्वनम्।वीक्षमाणा दिशः सर्वा दुद्रुवुर्वानरर्षभाः ।। ६.८२.१ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhīmanirhrādaṁ śakrāśanisamasvanam।vīkṣamāṇā diśaḥ sarvā dudruvurvānararṣabhāḥ ।। 6.82.1 ।।

translations.english: The bulls among Vanaras heard the roar which was like thunder and looking at Indrajith fled in all directions.
